notes.title: 💌 Carefully Stamped Demo – Out Now! 💌
notes.notes:
Welcome to the cozy world of postcards!  
The demo for [i]Carefully Stamped[/i] is now live – try your hand at designing and sending charming mail to quirky customers.  

[b]✨ What’s inside the demo:[/b]  
– Craft postcards to match unique customer requests  
– Decorate with stickers, washi tapes, and doodles  
– Drop them in the mailbox and watch the magic happen  

Relax, create, and share joy one postcard at a time. 🎨✉️  

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3803870/Carefully_Stamped/]👉 Play the demo today and let us know what you think![/url]
